verdict.rationale: Base44 documents prompt-driven iteration, where AI updates code, styles and components from natural-language requests. Some safeguards are relevant to 'not breaking' things: previews shown before changes are applied, a testing agent that runs browser tests on key flows, and GitHub version control. Community users report that the 'resolve with AI' fix flow 'just works', but no evidence describes scoped edits, regression guarantees or a built-in undo/rollback for prompt edits. Missing for 10: documented protection against regressions from follow-up prompts, in-editor version history/rollback, independent hands-on reports of multi-prompt iteration staying stable.

support.subject: As a founder, I can refine my app through follow-up prompts without breaking what already works

citations.quote: Describe what you want in natural language, and AI updates code, styles, and components for you.
AI shows previews before it touches anything.
The testing agent runs browser-based tests on your app's key flows, simulating real user interactions
Connect your Base44 app to GitHub for version control, local development, and collaboration.
Base has resolve with AI functionality, which is far superior to anything I've seen outside of an IDE. It just works.
